newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market lively at $71 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market lively at $71 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher, according to USDA.
Inquiry and demand strong. Sales confirmed on 17,000 slaughter steers and 9,800 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date 95,900 head confirmed including 9,700 head or about 10 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1325 lbs 71.00, few 1375 lbs 68.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 71.00, pen mixed Commercial to Choice 1100 lb heifers and heiferettes 69.00.
Wk to date - 95,900 last week - 4,400 last year - 39,800
